company_name: Shenzhen Rongda Photosensitive Science & Technology Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-end photosensitive chemical materials used in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Shenzhen Rongda Photosensitive Science & Technology Co., Ltd. is a national high-tech enterprise focused on producing advanced photosensitive chemical materials for the LED, flat panel display, and integrated circuit industries. The company emphasizes R&D and has established collaborations with academic institutions to enhance its innovation capabilities.
capabilities: Development of adhesion promoters and anti-reflective coatings
Manufacturing of developers and ancillary materials
technical_expertise: Intellectual property development in chemical materials

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Shenzhen, China, and has established a national joint laboratory for micro-lithography materials.
